frozenEvaluator.compatibilityFinding: Every raw stdout ends with llama.cpp's exact [end of text] sentinel after a grammar-complete JSON object. The frozen strict parser does not strip this runtime sentinel, so its valid/truncation metrics cannot isolate semantic behavior. This is an implementation compatibility defect and receives no passing credit.

independentSentinelNormalizedDiagnostic.normalization: Removed only terminal whitespace plus the exact [end of text] runtime sentinel; retained and disclosed original raw stdout.
independentSentinelNormalizedDiagnostic.finding: Semantic calibration fails decisively even after diagnostic-only sentinel normalization. The model invents present danger observations on routine, outside-scope, invalid, mimic, and injection cases.

untouchedEvaluation.reason: Frozen calibration returned exit code 2, so GitHub Actions skipped the untouched 100-case evaluation step.

decision: Reject the product-contract revision. Do not tune on untouched evaluation, do not run human or physical gates, do not create evidence/model-decision.json, and do not enter Phase 2 or UI.
